note: I028 Tier 5: travel writing, the Captain's pastime in place of the little game (I022, kept for its history). A work is written in sessions of two hours; each session the Captain chooses an angle, and the angle that suits the topic counts more. Topics come from what really happened (TravelWriting.topics). A finished work is published at once: modest income and renown, a world event (the Traveller Network, the magazine). 'needs' gates a form on real experience. Text fields are translated.

angles.text: Write about the sea and the weather
